# Unity test packages

Every one of these files was made by Everloom from its own CC0 test models (`tests/fixtures/avatars/models`), with
`tools/avatars/unity-fixture.py` and `tools/avatars/make-unity-fixture.ts`. CC0 1.0.

- `Ava.unitypackage`: an avatar laid out like a VRChat one (humanoid .meta, lilToon materials, descriptor, PhysBones, a blendshape preset, a hidden hat with a toggle, a script).
- `AvaShirt.unitypackage`: a shirt made for it (Modular Avatar Merge Armature, bones prefixed `Outfit_`).
- `Ava-extracted/`, `Ava-extracted-nometa/`: the avatar as loose files, with and without .meta files.
